title: Data everywhere, but are they fit for purpose?
title_zh: 数据无处不在，但它们是否适用？
abstract: Vast amounts of new data are fundamentally shaping how people manage their lives and do their work. The volume is overwhelming—Google Dataset Search discovers 2 million new datasets every month—and so are the uses by scientists, governments, and the public. Governments across the world are treating data as a strategic asset. But data alone are not enough. Infrastructure must be developed that can provide signals about which data are “fit for purpose” for the increasingly vast number of potential uses. Informed and appropriate use is, after all, the ultimate objective of making data available for the public good.
abstract_zh: 大量新数据正在根本性地改变人们管理生活和工作的方式。数据量令人不堪重负——Google Dataset Search 每月发现 200 万个新数据集——科学家、政府和公众的使用也同样庞大。全球各国政府正将数据视为战略资产。然而，仅有数据并不足够。必须开发基础设施，能够提供关于哪些数据“适用于特定目的”的信号，以满足日益增长的潜在用途。毕竟，信息化和恰当使用才是让数据为公共利益服务的最终目标。
